Olga / Laura — quick technical read and recommended language snippets. High level: private deployment + customer-managed KMS is feasible with constraints; EU-only routing for regulated datasets doable but requires order form scoping and a routing SLA.

Technical notes (summary):
- KMS/HSM: We can support customer-managed keys for a dedicated private deployment (VPC + HSM) but only for data at rest and in-flight termination within the private cluster. We cannot currently support dual-ownership keys that span hosted + private without a separate tenant. Suggested DPA addition: "Customer may require customer-managed KMS for identified datasets; Redwood will provide a dedicated private deployment with HSM integration per Order Form SOW."
- Annex II: If Novapath insists on enumerating subprocessors, we recommend a rolling exhibit instead of static Annex II; propose: "Subprocessors will be listed in Exhibit A and updated with 30 days' notice." That preserves flexibility and addresses their transparency ask.
- Routing / EU-only: We need an Order Form checkbox that flags "Contains regulated EU personal data — requires EU-only hosting and routing SLA". That will drive infra provisioning.

Attachments: SCCs-compare.xlsx (contains mapping between Novapath edits and our standard SCC text).

Proposed wording snippets you can hand to Legal: 
1) KMS clause: "Where Customer selects Customer-Managed Keys, Redwood will deploy a private tenant with HSM integration limited to the scoped datasets described in the Order Form."
2) Annex approach: "Subprocessor list will be maintained in Exhibit A; Customer may request specific subprocessor confirmation prior to go-live and Redwood will accommodate reasonable checks."

I can join the Tuesday call to walk infra constraints.

Tom / Sara — thanks for sending the redline and for the patience while we reviewed. Attached is a short legal response with proposed compromise language (we can push redlines into DocuSign once you accept the approach).

Key legal positions:
- Indemnity / warranty: We cannot accept open-ended secondary indemnities tied to customer downstream claims. Proposed compromise: narrow the indemnity to gross negligence and willful misconduct, and include cap tied to aggregate Order Form fees for the prior 12 months.
- Annex II / Subprocessors: We are comfortable with a maintained Exhibit A for subprocessors and will commit to 30 days' notice for material changes. For any US-based subprocessors handling regulated PHI, we will offer a scoped EU-only routing carveout set in the Order Form.
- KMS: We will accept customer-managed KMS for scoped datasets on a dedicated private deployment, subject to an Order Form SOW, reasonable implementation fees, and a security acceptance test. Suggested wording from Marcus is included below.

Requested next steps:
1) If Novapath confirms the list of regulated data classes and their volume estimate, we will scope the Order Form SOW and return a commercial impact estimate within 5 business days.
2) If procurement is ready, please share any PO templates — we can align DocuSign timeline to your procurement window.
